title: Cancel the Neighbours
statement:
A word is written in lowercase letters. As long as the word contains two equal letters next to each other, you may delete that pair; the letters on both sides then become neighbours. The final word does not depend on the order of deletions. Find the final word.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the final word. If nothing is left, print `EMPTY`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
